notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten power worth of creatures excluding Mossbridge Troll.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Activate Mossbridge Troll by tapping creatures you control with a total power of ten or greater, giving Mossbridge Troll +20/+20.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, winning the game.
